player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''WorldChamp''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.

starting.card: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe

description: This deck uses Brangus to win the Podrace w/Podracer collisions, and then use Gardulla to get everything back. It also uses Maul, Vader, Mara, and Palpy to drain and battle. Manipulation screws the opponent so he can't do anything.

notes: Published title 'Post-Coruscant SYC Racing Jizz' not used as the page title: 'jizz' is read as crude sexual slang; the page is Philip Marschall DS and the published title stays in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (9): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer, Watto's Box, Start Your Engines!; these count toward the 60.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the post calls itself post-Coruscant and lists Coruscant cards (Gardulla The Hutt, Darth Maul, Young Apprentice).

Posted 'DS DB' (starting and x2 under Locations) dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), the docking bay Set Your Course For Alderaan deploys; the extra copies feed Brangus Glee's docking-bay exchange.

Posted 'Vader w/Stick' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Maul (tat)' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Onith' dested M'iiyoom Onith; 'Palpy' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Mara' and 'Mara's Stick' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand and Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Alderaan, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room) ('Echo War Room'), Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm ('Lars Farm') and Control dested to their Dark pages.
The strategy mentions Fear, but no Fear card is listed; nothing added.
